note: PROVISIONAL. Shot Line, Paint Boost, 3PT Boost, Def Boost and the Speed/Power budget come from dunksandthrees' ACTUAL 2025-26 season page, REGULAR SEASON AND PLAYOFFS POOLED — playoff games are folded in as additional data, each stat volume-weighted by the denominator it is a rate over (possessions for EPM/OFF/DEF, true shooting attempts for TS%, the relevant attempts for each location percentage, games for EW/GP); a player whose team missed the playoffs is unchanged. The 19 force-included players ALSO have their 2024-25 season folded in by the same volume weighting, because they are in the pool despite failing the G>=40 rule and several of them played under twenty games; no other player is blended. The shooting three are the stated probability rule (a player misses at his real miss rate) compressed onto the finished set's own distribution. Charts are still synthesized from the PREDICTED per-100 rates, because the actual page carries no per-100 rebound or assist counts. See scripts/cardgen/shooting.js, scripts/cardgen/poolSeasons.js and card-data/generated/card-calibration.json.
